sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "city"."County_ID" AS e, AVG((CAST("city"."Hispanic" AS REAL) / "city"."White")) AS m1, AVG((CAST(("city"."Asian" - "city"."Multiracial") AS REAL) / "city"."Multiracial")) AS m2 FROM "city" GROUP BY "city"."County_ID"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
